jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Hazen Union School District (Union High School District No. 26), a union high school district in the Orleans Southwest Supervisory Union (member towns Greensboro, Hardwick, Woodbury).

sources.note: Hazen Union School District board roster sheet (Orleans Southwest SU, official): eight directors -- Hardwick: Margaret Bledsoe (Vice Chair, term end 2029), Terri Vest (2029), Patrick Kane (2028), Sabrina Morrison (Clerk, 2027); Greensboro: Jan Terwiesch (2028), Christian Holland (1-year term, 2027); Woodbury: Steven Freihofner (Chair, 2029), Laura Murphy (2028). The same eight are listed in the August 18, 2026 board agenda. Seats are town-allocated with TOWN-ONLY electorates (Union High School District No. 26, 16 V.S.A. section 748; Hardwick's official 2026 open-offices notice puts two Hazen 3-year seats on Hardwick's own Australian ballot). Christian Holland was HELD at build time (the roster sheet's '1-year term' gloss left his seating uncertified) and was MINTED ELECTED on 2026-10-25 under Walter's ruling, on Greensboro's official 2026 Town Report (p. 3, 'Greensboro Town Elected Officers': listed under 'Union 26 School Board (Hazen)' with a regular 3-year term expiring 2027; he does not appear in the report's Selectboard Appointments list, p. 4), with the term-length conflict disclosed in his own source notes. The district's articles of agreement were not fetched; the allocation rests on the roster sheet + town notices.

Town of Greensboro 2026 Town Report (official, greensborovt.gov), p. 3 ('Greensboro Town Elected Officers'): under 'Union 26 School Board (Hazen)', Christian Holland is listed with a regular 3-year term expiring 2027 (alongside Jan Terwiesch, (3 yr) (2028)); the report's Selectboard Appointments list (p. 4) does not include him. Minted ELECTED on this elected-officers listing (Walter's ruling, 2026-10-25). No election return naming Holland was located -- Greensboro's March 3, 2026 warning elects town officers only -- so no exact election date or vote total is asserted; the regular 3-year term expiring 2027 implies election in the normal 2024 cycle.

Hazen Union School District board roster sheet (Orleans Southwest SU, official): Christian Holland (Greensboro) is listed among the district's eight current directors, as in the August 18, 2026 board agenda. CONFLICT DISCLOSED: this sheet glosses his seat as a '1-year term, 2027', against the Greensboro 2026 Town Report's elected-officers listing of a regular 3-year term expiring 2027; the town report governs and he is minted ELECTED.
